name: list what only a human can check
about: The checks a person has to do by hand, listed for them just before the merge gate, in the bullet format `sb presets design-gate` prints. Include only what no agent could verify — end-to-end flows needing a real device or session, and UI that is new or visibly changed. Name the route and what should be seen there: which screens to open, which controls to exercise. Exclude everything already covered, always: logic under test, queries an agent ran itself, untouched UI. Repeating a check that passed is asking a person to redo an agent's work. No filler, no restating the diff. If nothing genuinely needs a human, say so and skip with that reason. This list exists to shorten review-to-ship, and every line that does not need a person lengthens it. Obliged by `merge`: it appears with every merge step named from the library, and it may be skipped with a reason — a one-line docs change needs no manual pass — but never left out.
